overloads.semanticRole: The SQL SET OPTION command modifies the value of the option passed in option .

constraints: option identifies which SQL-theme setting to change (e.g. SQL asynchronous, SQL charset, SQL connection timeout); the expected type and valid range of value depend on which option constant is passed, per the SQL theme constants documentation.
SQL connection timeout must be set before opening the connection (i.e. before SQL LOGIN) in order to take effect.
